tools.description:
Search TimePlex for massage, headspa, hair salon, spa, Korean body scrub, makeup and semi-permanent makeup shops in Seoul and Korea — non-medical beauty and wellness services for travelers.
USE THIS TOOL WHEN: the user wants to find, explore, compare, get recommendations for, check availability of,

tools.description:
Get the services, prices, durations, weekly business hours and bookable staff or seats of one specific TimePlex shop (slug from search_shops).

tools.name: search_availability
tools.description:
Check real-time appointment availability for one TimePlex shop (slug from search_shops, items from get_shop_services) on a date, optionally at a time. All times are Korea Standard Time (KST).
USE THIS TOOL WHEN: the user asks whether an appointment is available, asks for open slots or possible times

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Use this tool only for a shop that is already in the Timeplex catalog but cannot be booked online yet: a search_shops result with bookable=false, or a newly joined shop whose menu is not registered yet (get_shop_services says so). It submits a booking request for that shop — Timeplex concierge staff

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description:
Build a prefilled TimePlex booking link (Book Now card) for a bookable=true shop. The customer opens it, enters contact details and pays; the shop then approves. Flow: search_shops → get_shop_services → search_availability → start_booking (link) → customer payment → shop approval → confirmed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_shops, start_booking · Private data: search_availability, request_booking, start_booking · Public sink: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_shops, start_booking · Private data: search_availability, request_booking, start_booking · Public sink: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_shops" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
